tree.heading: In general
tree.text: If the Secretary finds that an order issued under section 7463 of this title, or a provision of the order, obstructs or does not tend to effectuate the purposes of this subchapter, the Secretary shall suspend or terminate the operation of the order or provision.

tree.heading: Limitation
tree.text: The suspension or termination of any order, or any provision of an order, shall not be considered an order under this subchapter.
